setting: You are both in Recife, Brazil, and you know each other from a holiday that brought you together there. Renata is a bookkeeper working on her clients' year-end accounts, and Felipe is a software developer tied up with a project release. You are both using this chat to swap plans for meeting up again and to share updates on your busy schedules.

text: [photo: Boa Viagem beach at sunset, the tide out]
Finally got out of the office before dark 🌅
That's the spot from the first day right
Yeah same spot. No one on it, weird
Release is still on for thurs. Been in the repo since 8
Pray for you 🙏 my client sent me a shoebox of receipts today. A SHOEBOX
The paper kind?
The paper kind. 3 years of it
Still on for saturday? I can do after 4 if the release doesn't eat it
Sat after 4 works. Where tho, the market at boa vista?
Fine by me. The one with the bad tapioca is on me this time
Lol deal. I'll bring receipts to bribe the accountant gods 😂
Ci is green. First time all day
Go to bed felipe
One more thing first
Still at the receipts. One client's bank statement is in two different currencies and nobody told me
Which two
Usd and brl. The usd part is in a different account number from the rest, like they opened a second account and didn't mention it
So nobody told you because nobody knew
Possibly I'm going to pretend that's fine and sleep
Branch is cut. Going to bed now, really
Go to bed felipe 🙄
Slept until 9. Feels illegal
Lucky. I had a client call at 8, he wanted to talk about the "missing" 2k
It was a transfer to his own card. He forgot. 2 hrs of my life
Should have billed him for the 2 hrs
I did
Staging is green again. Deploy Thurs morning if nothing else breaks
[photo: receipts on the dining table, sorted into piles]
Left pile is "probably fine". Middle is "why". Right is the shoebox's ghost
What's the total
No idea lol. Ok lunch, the shoebox won this round
Sat still ok? Market or do you want somewhere with a view
Market is fine. Bring cash, the card machine at the tapioca place is unreliable
Also the bad tapioca is non-negotiable
Wouldn't dream of negotiating it
Can't look at another receipt tonight. Going to bed
Good. Sleep
Coffee first. Then the shoebox
Did you find the 2k or was that a different one
Different one. This is the USD account
Standup ran 40 min because someone wanted to rename a variable
Which variable
Doesn't matter. It's "customerRecord" now instead of "cust" and everyone's happy
[photo: a faded receipt from a tapioca place, date half-cut off]
Is this one ours? From the first week
Can't tell, the amount's gone. Could be anyone's bad tapioca
Rude
Release notes are half done. Writing them is the worst part somehow
Client wants the report by friday now 🙃
Did you say no
Said "I'll see what I can do," which is how it starts
Market still on for Sat. Checked the weather, no rain
Ok good. Bring the umbrella anyway
Sure
Pushed the fix. Tests green. Going to watch whatever's on and not think about it
Found it. The bank split the statement by currency and the client never looked. 3 hrs of my life, again
Bill him
Already did 😂
